T-FEATURE.note: Owner approved concept-b, The Walkthrough, as the T-FEATURE template. RE-STAMPED after a stale-receipt catch described below. Governs 8 pages: seo-services, web-design, ui-ux-design, web-development, cro-services, graphic-design, branding, las-vegas-seo. Promoted against seo-services, the flagship and per its own brief the load-bearing page of the mega menu. AT THIS STAMP: full battery 52 of 52, failCount 0, noGates false, filtered empty, receipt fresh against the fragment AND the template NOT newer than the receipt. THE STALE-RECEIPT CATCH, recorded because the gate cannot catch it. The first T-FEATURE stamp was taken on a genuine 52 of 52, but the repetition-repair agent reported AFTER the stamp and its second round had edited the template and the copy SSOT 14 minutes after the receipt was written. verify-stamp-has-receipt binds freshness to the FRAGMENT mtime and records no template hash, so the stale state passed every check: receipt fresh versus fragment true, while template newer than receipt was ALSO true. The stamp was therefore vouching for a fragment built from an older template. Caught by checking the three mtimes by hand rather than trusting the gate. Re-promoted from the current template, re-verified, re-stamped. THE RULE: after ANY edit to a concept, re-promote before stamping, and verify template mtime is not newer than receipt ts. A receipt that is fresh against its fragment says nothing about whether the fragment still matches the concept. THE REPETITION FIX, the last gate to clear and the hardest, because most flagged phrasing IS the contractual core restated deliberately. The agent was required to build its own enumerator on the gate's exact constants and CALIBRATE it against the five phrases the gate actually prints, because the gate truncates its report at five. Calibration reproduced the gate's output line for line and in order, which is what makes the rest of the enumeration trustworthy. It then measured the true set at 30 flagged grams and 10 maximal families across 10 sections, and cleared all 10 in a single planned round that introduced no new families. NOTE A CORRECTION TO MY OWN BRIEF: I told the agent an earlier verifier had measured 49 phrase families. The calibrated enumerator measures 10 maximal families. Since the calibration matches the gate byte for byte, 10 is the trustworthy figure and my 49 was an uncalibrated number taken from another agent's report. OWNERSHIP was assigned before editing: S6 owns the billing pause and resume mechanic, S3 owns how phrases are chosen and where they are recorded. Every other mention became a named cross-reference to a stage the page's own numerals make unambiguous, never a reordering of words to defeat the matcher. SIX CONTRACTUAL STATEMENTS were protected by name and all six survive verbatim in the promoted fragment: the payment condition, page one of Google organic results, in an agreed geography, the monthly assessment cadence, the no-algorithm-control disclaimer, and the resumption term. FIVE DE-DUPLICATIONS WERE DECLINED and the reasons recorded: the H1 because it carries both the measurement and the payment condition; S3 point 2 against S8 charge 01 because each must stand alone unambiguously and both sit under the section floor anyway; S6 beats 2 to 4 because S6 is the designated owner of the canonical checkable terms; and the S1 and S6 figcaption legends because each diagram's legend must be readable at its own diagram. The word refund was avoided in a rewrite because the honesty perimeter bans it. TWO INTEGRITY FIXES BEYOND THE GATE, both found by the agent rather than required by me. First, a pre-existing divergence between the copy SSOT and the template on one S6 sentence, inherited from an earlier de-dup pass; the md was synced TO the template rather than the reverse, because restoring the md version would have put a 10-word sentence into both S6 and S8 and tripped the verbatim-sentence rule. Second, an S2 header comment that its own edit had made false: the comment claimed a sentence was set verbatim and unsplit, and the edit split it. The comment was corrected rather than left as a false record. THE TOURNAMENT: all three concepts failed adversarial verification on 13 miscitations between them, every citation resolving and none describing what was built. Concept-b won because its defects were corrections rather than rebuilds. All 10 picks now carry MENU plus number plus FULL ENTRY NAME. THREE PROCESS FAILURES OF MINE ON THIS STAMP, all recorded because the pattern matters more than the incident. A file that looks momentarily stable is not an agent that has finished; wait for the completion signal. THIRD, I reported zero occurrences of the banned token after grepping only for the percent-sign form, when the actual violation was the token spelled out as one hundred percent in words. T-INDEX.note: Owner approved concept-b, The Board, as the T-INDEX template on a full-battery 52 of 52 (failCount 0, noGates false, filtered empty), receipt fresh against the fragment AND the template NOT newer than the receipt, re-verified immediately before stamping. Governs 4 pages: results, our-locations, seo-blog, videos. Promoted against results, the evidence page a sceptic reaches after the guarantee terms. THIS TOURNAMENT FOUND A GATE THAT HAD NEVER BEEN ALIVE, and that is the most consequential finding of the build so far. verify-card-grid-consistent exists to catch the defect the OWNER caught at full resolution: a router grid where only the flagship card carries a photo and the rest are media-less, reading half built. Its own header records that verify-not-flat and verify-section-density both passed that defect. But it groups cards into a judgeable grid only when consecutive cards are separated by WHITESPACE ONLY, and requires a run of at least four, while this build system MANDATES the DOM grammar section, container, row, col, object, which puts a col div between every pair of cards. Every run therefore ended at length one, never reached four, and the gate never judged anything. PROVEN BY TWO-ARM CONTROL on identical content, one card with an image plus four media-less cards: grammar-conformant markup exited 0 and MISSED it, raw sibling markup exited 2 and caught it. THE ORDER OF DISCOVERY MATTERS AND IS RECORDED: a concept AUTHOR found it first and disclosed its own pass as vacuous rather than banking it, writing that the gate cannot fire on any grammar-conformant page and that its compliance rested on construction rather than on the gate verdict. A VERIFIER then confirmed it independently by stripping media from four of five cards and watching the gate stay green. I confirmed it third with the control above. THE GENERALISABLE LESSON: a gate can be defeated not by a bug in the gate but by a DIFFERENT RULE OF THE SAME SYSTEM changing the shape the gate keys on. Neither rule is wrong alone, and nobody notices because the gate keeps exiting 0. When a system both MANDATES a structure and GATES on structure, the two must be checked against each other, not each against the code. OWNER RULED to fix it. A wrapper is now transparent for run-grouping if and only if it carries the grammar cell token col or a col modifier AND contains exactly one card and nothing else. The justification is that a col is PROVABLY layout-only, because the sibling gate verify-dom-structure enforces that a col may never carry a skin class, which makes the modifier breadth inert rather than loose. Row, container and section stay opaque deliberately, which is what still ends a run at a row or section break and stops two rows merging. VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY BY ME, 7 of 7 controls: conformant one-photo-plus-four-blanks now exits 2 where it exited 0 an hour earlier; raw siblings still exit 2; all-media, all-blank, a short run of three and a heading break all exit 0; and two separate rows of all-photo then all-icon correctly do NOT merge. All three ALREADY-STAMPED pages still exit 0, so no stamped page was shipping an inconsistent grid. The gate now judges four real grids it previously could not see; five of six files produced only runs of length one before the fix. WHY IT SURVIVED, which is the third stale-fixture finding of this build and the sharpest: the shipped smoke is 10 of 10 green and always was, because EVERY ONE of its fixtures builds cards as raw adjacent siblings and not one wraps a card in a col. The suite only ever exercised the shape the gate could already see, so it stayed green through the entire period the gate was dead on every real page. A TEST SUITE THAT ONLY TESTS THE SHAPES THE CODE ALREADY HANDLES CANNOT DETECT THAT THE CODE HANDLES NOTHING ELSE. The fixture needs one grammar-conformant case added; the repairing agent flagged it and correctly left it as out of scope. ALL THREE CONCEPTS FAILED VERIFICATION. concept-a The Record had the only fully clean citation set, five of five byte-exact with no substitution needed, and failed on one blocking gate plus four claim-versus-measurement defects in its own header. concept-c The Routing Table miscited PROOF-SECTIONS 4 at its pinned section for an object that is not a case study. concept-b was picked for its figure-ground and repaired. ITS BLOCKING GATE was verify-grid-accent, exit 2 from two paragraphs carrying bw-body, where the canonical sheet documents that class as the page single continuous ground painted ONCE on main, with prose taking bw-copy from there on. Zero in all three stamped pages, zero in both siblings, two here. TWO HONESTY DEFECTS THAT NO GATE CATCHES were also repaired. FIRST, the page named a control it did not have: zero controls measured in main at every width, yet the copy referred to a category filter above and three card feet read BOUND TO THE CATEGORY CONTROL. The origin is instructive: that sentence is APPROVED COPY written for a page that HAD the three controls the brief declares, and the build correctly REMOVED the dead filter while incorrectly KEEPING the prose that presupposes it. REMOVING A FEATURE OBLIGES A SWEEP OF THE COPY FOR REFERENCES TO IT, and no gate enforces that. SECOND, the file own defence artifact lied: the header claimed nothing on the page was rewritten, while measurement found 610 of 1461 rendered words authored rather than drawn from the approved copy. The ruling applied was that labels, captions, legends and card furniture are legitimate LAYOUT-level authoring and may stay, that any NEW SENTENCE ASSERTING A FACT must go, and that the header claim must be corrected to the measurement. THE REPAIRING AGENT WENT BEYOND ITS BRIEF THREE TIMES, each time correctly. It found two false legend claims I never named, asserting that a start and end month and the method were on record when the verbatim approved paragraph above them records only a hire month and year, a stated duration, a named phrase, a geography and a page movement. It found build vocabulary leaking into client copy and rewrote it. And it closed a composition void by RESTORING an approved sentence the build had silently dropped and removing a third onward link the approved copy never authorised, rather than by padding, while deliberately LEAVING a second gap because that tile is unboxed and simply ends earlier with no bounded empty field. IT ALSO CORRECTED ME TWICE: my brief asserted that one grid carried media on all five cards when measurement shows all sixteen cards on the page are media-less, a figure I had taken from a verifier report and passed on without checking, which is the third time this session I have relayed an unverified number as fact. It also showed my negative control for bw-body was too weak, since the gate fails only above one instance so causality reproduces only when both are restored. AT STAMP TIME: 52 of 52, receipt bound to the current template, fragment 36022 bytes carrying 0 em or en dashes, 0 bracket tokens, 0 banned percent tokens, and its card grids judged consistent by a gate that could not have judged them an hour earlier. OPEN AND NOT RESOLVED: the card-grid smoke still lacks a grammar-conformant fixture; concept-a and concept-c remain unrepaired as tournament evidence; the T-MARQUEE ledger 15 picks still carry bare numbers; verify-stat-treatment is blind to bw-numeral while the stamped seo-services page carries six such figures; verify-no-unfilled-slots has a dead _design scope branch; two sibling skill forks carry the bracket-placeholder gap; verify-fabricated-honesty claim half never fires on these briefs; six brand-card and chrome concepts remain unjudged by verify-not-flat; and the owner-pending values are still owed as rendered copy.

Governs 3 pages: contact-us, thank-you, 404. Promoted against contact-us, the site's single conversion destination for all 26 pages and the 301 target for 8 retired URLs. THE OWNER DELEGATED THE PICK TO ME AND MY STATED RATIONALE WAS PARTLY WRONG. For the first time in six tournaments the GATES COULD NOT DISCRIMINATE: all three concepts passed all 18 gates I ran at the real promote path shape, and all three carried 4 of 4 citations with full entry names. I picked concept-a on two judgement grounds.
